feeds.title: Nature's Ki Blog
feeds.description: In Japanese philosophy 'Ki' means circulating life energy. At Nature's Ki, we believe that our pets are individuals with complex personalities and unique needs. They form an integral part of our immediate family and caring for them to the best of our abilities requires access to high-quality products and the latest information available. Find out all the best pet food information from our award-winning brands like Orijen, Acana, Higgins, and The Original Poop Bags. Plus, read the latest news, and get tips and tricks for looking after your pets!

feeds.title: Jetpets Blog
feeds.description: Jetpets is a testament to Sandy's original vision, of safely and comfortably transporting thousands of pets around the globe every year. The Jetpets Blog is where we share with you the latest amazing pet travel stories and what's happening behind the scenes at Jetpets.

feeds.title: MicroMed Blog
feeds.description: Hi, we're Maria and Mike and we are the founders of MicroMed. We're both hugely passionate about animals and 'life' on our planet. We've spent hundreds of hours toiling away in the garden looking after our collection of cows, pigs, goats, sheep, chickens, you name it! We created MicroMed to help pet owners provide better care for their animals by supporting their skin, gut, and digestive health, as well as immunity and overall well-being.

feeds.title: Yellow Lab Blog
feeds.description: My name is Salome and I am a pet photographer. See recent dog and owner photo shoots, articles, and how to photograph your dog with your iPhone blogs and stay up to date with upcoming events or announcements of special Yellow Lab offers.

feeds.title: VetsOne Blog
feeds.description: Our vision is to Enhance Animal-Human Relationships and our mission is to be the most trusted & customer-focused provider of animal health & welfare services in Hawke's Bay. Read our latest news and newsletters for our tips and tricks on caring for your pets.

feeds.title: Pet Life Magazine
feeds.description: Pet Life is a magazine for animal lovers and people who love their pets. Full of engaging content, awesome photos, tips, and inspiring stories. Dogs, cats, pocket pets, horses, fish, turtles, exotics, and more - we cover them all.

feeds.title: Blog
feeds.description: We are a family-owned business in Canterbury NZ and we are also a registered company. Blog posts are written by our experienced team are designed to help you with your pet from puppies to dogs. Find articles sharing essential Do's and Dont's for Dog care with healthy insights.

feeds.title: Thinkdog Blog
feeds.description: Our purpose at ThinkDog is not just to train your dog to sit and stay, but to help you develop a mutually beneficial relationship that prioritizes the well-being of both ends of the leash. By teaching you, the guardian, how to both understand and work with your dog, we can empower them to not only cope in this weird and wacky human world but thrive.

feeds.title: Healthy Pets New Zealand
feeds.description: Healthy Pets NZ is a registered charity that supports research into improved health and welfare for Kiwi pets. Established by the Companion Animal Branch of the New Zealand Veterinary Association in 1998, we are a team of volunteer veterinary professionals including veterinarians, researchers, veterinary nurses, and educators passionate about outcome focussed research that assists companion animals.

feeds.title: Urban Dogs NZ Blog
feeds.description: Urban dogs provide a fun, safe, all-weather environment where you can drop your dog off and we will fill their days with activities, naps, hugs, treats, and plenty of dog social time- so that at the end of the day, you pick up a happy, pooped pup! We are proud not to only offer a quality daycare facility for dogs, but a community of like-minded, dog-loving people.

feeds.title: VetSouth Blog
feeds.description: VetSouth was born out of the belief that being rural and far away shouldn't compromise the quality of veterinary services that we are able to provide. Read regular newsletters with vet care articles, tips on animal health, and current deals on animal products.

feeds.title: The Good Pet Home Blog
feeds.description: At THE GOOD PET HOME, we search the globe to bring you premium pet products for you, your home, and your furry friend. With design always at the forefront of the mind, enjoy our latest curation of unique and exclusive finds.

feeds.title: Animal Outfitters NZ Blog
feeds.description: Animal Outfitters is a brand that helps make life with your pet stylish, effortless, and fun. We're passionate about our dogs and what we do. Animal Outfitters is our way of sharing a piece of that with you and your pet. Read our blog for tips, tricks, recipes, and ideas to make life with your dog or cat effortless, stylish and fun.

feeds.title: The Pet Edit Blog
feeds.description: The Pet Edit Blog is an honest interpretation of the pet world as I see it and all products featured on my blog are there because I genuinely like them. Pet and lifestyle blog because life is oh, so much better with pets! Featuring only the very best functional, fashionable pet products.

feeds.description: Best Mate Dog training will teach you the skills to get them to listen to you, even when there's something more exciting going on, and show you how to get those ears turned on, even when they can't smell food in your pocket. International pet transport blog about shipping cats and dogs overseas.

feeds.description: Not only will your dogs love Possyum Supreme and Superior Chunky dog rolls and dog treats, but you'll rest easy knowing they are eating the best dog food.

feeds.description: At Halifax Veterinary center we're focused on preventive care to keep your pets happy and healthy. We aim to detect the small issues with the furriest members of your family before they become major health problems.

feeds.title: Smack Bang Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to get pet owners to start thinking about the items they buy for their pets in the same way they would buy something for themselves or their homes. We believe in harmony between function and design. Read Regular yarns about our favorite and new products and brands, trends, customer and staff spotlights, and industry insights.

feeds.title: Share My Pet Blog
feeds.description: Share My pet aims to enrich the lives of pets and people. feeds.description: We have been serving up the most balanced, nutritious raw pet food to our cat and dog-loving customers since 2013.
